name: Glendale Youth Alliance Summer Youth Employment and Youth@Work
what_you_do: Youth ages 14 to 24 get paid work experience. The Brush Clearance track is a 6 week supervised brush removal job for youth 14 to 16. Youth with basic job skills can be placed in community jobs.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 24. The page lists it as a first job or summer job program. GYA serves youth from Glendale, Burbank and La Canada-Flintridge and the greater Los Angeles County area.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The hourly rate is not listed.
deadline_text: The GYA programs page marks this program "FUNDING EXHAUSTED FOR 2026-27 PROGRAM YEAR". No dates or deadlines are posted for a later year.
how_to_apply: Funding is marked exhausted for 2026-27, so ask the office before counting on a spot. One online Apply Now form covers all GYA programs. A case worker contacts you in 3 to 5 business days. Office: 1255 S Central Ave, Glendale; (818) 937-8073, Mon to Fri 8 to 5.
notes: The page does not give the hourly rate or weekly hours, so ask the office. The GYA page does not mention work permits. Checked 2026-11-02: the page says funding is exhausted for the 2026-27 program year and does not say when it returns. Left unconfirmed.
